testcase.name: request contract is tenant-safe, concurrent, and idempotent
normal subject PII is absent from every active store
financial truth and shared unrelated records are retained
retained financial links remain anonymous and support a later private refund
post-erasure refunds preserve financial correctness without restoring PII
failed post-erasure refunds remain private and retry safely
merchant credentials remain usable after customer erasure
customer erasure preserves unrelated customer and merchant-platform survivors
failed erasure retries safely and pending asynchronous work is sanitized before completion
delayed webhook and document work cannot reintroduce PII
historical event replay is suppressed by durable erasure state
survivor remains unchanged after replay and delayed work
